name: Transfer Specialist - Existing Loan on Property Balance Transfer
description: Borrower wants to transfer their current home/property loan from another bank. Routes directly to loan transfer specialist.
turns: Actually, I already have a loan against this property and want to transfer it to lower my interest.

name: Transfer Specialist - Lower EMI on Existing Property Loan
description: Customer asks to reduce EMI on their existing running property loan during the call.
turns: It is a residential apartment, but can you reduce emi on my current property loan?

name: Busy Customer - Schedule Callback
description: Customer is busy at work/driving and provides a preferred callback time. Engine ends call politely without pushing checklist.
turns: Yes, Arjun speaking, but I am in a client meeting right now. Please call back tomorrow evening.

name: Wrong Person - Polite Apology and Exit
description: The person answering is not the intended customer. Agent apologizes without disclosing loan details and ends call.
turns: No, you have the wrong number, there is no Rajesh here.

name: Customer Declines Offer - Respectful Exit
description: Customer states they are not interested in taking any loan.
turns: No thanks, I am not interested in taking any loan.
